before: Justified East Asian lines spread between their characters, and automatic spacing opens between East Asian and Latin text, whatever the document defaults.
after: Both apply only when the styles part omits w:rPrDefault or names an East Asian font in its w:rFonts. Otherwise a justified East Asian line stretches only its spaces and no automatic spacing opens, except beside runs that name an East Asian font on a distributed line.
reason: Only layout geometry changes. Canonical OOXML, source positions, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged. Every peer derives the same geometry from the same styles part.
